title: $H$-tensional hypersurfaces in $4$-dimensional space forms
summary: In this paper, we investigate the classification of $H$-tensional hypersurfaces $M$ in a $4$-dimensional space form $N^4(c)$ of constant sectional curvature $c$. Our results show that minimal hypersurfaces are the only $H$-tensional hypersurfaces in $4$-dimensional space forms, thereby providing an affirmative partial answer to Conjecture 3 proposed in \cite{kacimi}.
